items.source: Is merging enabled for this particular instance?
items.translation: 此特定实例是否启用了合并？

items.source: IllegalStateException - if merging is not enabled for this instance (i.e. mergeEnabled equals false).
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果此实例未启用合并（即 mergeEnabled 等于 false）。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if the supplied parent is null
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果提供的父对象为 null

items.source:
The supplied object is considered the parent, and values in
the callee's value set must override those of the supplied object.
items.translation: 提供的对象被视为父对象，调用者的值集中的值必须覆盖提供对象的值。

items.source:
Interface representing an object whose value set can be merged with
that of a parent object.
items.translation: 表示其值集可与父对象值集合并的对象接口。

items.source: Merge the current value set with that of the supplied object.
items.translation: 将当前设置的值与提供的对象的值合并。

items.source: the result of the merge operation
